reply_text:
Thanks for telling me. I've kept it to this DM and haven't shared it with anyone, Ruth included.

You didn't ask me to do anything with it, so I haven't. Here are a few things I could do:
- Draft a briefing note to Ruth for you to send. It would be an internal email to a pemberline.com address.
- Set up time with Ruth on the calendar.
- Hold off until you've decided how to handle it.

Since the information is secondhand from Mateo, you may want to confirm it with him before it goes to Ruth. Tell me which option you want.
